verdict.rationale: Authy is a 2FA token authenticator with an associated verification API, so user-configured autonomous background automations fall outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability: encrypted cloud backup, multi-device sync and SDKs for sending verification tokens are core authenticator functions, not user-defined automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
